BiblicalUsage: Chamorah is a heap, and it appears once, in Samson's own boast: with the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the wordplay is the point: Samson piles the dead in heaps and names his heap after the ass's jaw that made it.
